work.title: String Quartet No. 2 in D major

version.value: Complete third movement; edition not identified
version.note: The Commons description gives only the title and movement. The cues cite the Belaieff first edition of the parts (1888) for markings.

value.name: Musopen String Quartet (as credited on Commons)

performers.note: Commons credits “Musopen String Quartet” as the artist. The individual players are not named in the sources consulted.

date.note: Commons dates the file 2012, and the Internet Archive’s Musopen collection lists Borodin’s two string quartets among the music released to the public domain by the project that completed in 2012. Whether 2012 is the session, release or upload date is not stated, so only the year is used.

place.note: No venue or city is given.

label.note: Musopen is a non-profit that raised money to record music and release it to the public domain.

catalogue.note: The Internet Archive collection has no catalogue number.

matrixTakeSides.note: A born-digital session has no matrix or take numbers.

credits.value: Uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by user Kcx36
credits.note: Commons file history; the upload comment names the Internet Archive’s Musopen collection as the source. No mastering engineer is named.

date.note: Commons upload date, not a session date.

processing.value: FLAC file on Commons; MP3 access derivative generated by Commons
processing.note: No editing or normalisation by Contrapunctus; one complete source stream.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative of a FLAC file; one source file, no concatenation or audio edits by Contrapunctus

composition.value: Public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms
composition.note: Borodin died on 27 February 1887. This says nothing about any modern edition.

recording.value: Public domain by Musopen’s release (Creative Commons Public Domain Mark); Commons tags the recording {{PD-author}} for Musopen
recording.note: The Internet Archive collection of the Musopen Kickstarter recordings carries the Public Domain Mark and lists Borodin’s String Quartets Nos. 1 and 2. Commons quotes Musopen’s requirement that uploaders warrant that content is in the public domain.

rights.creditLine: Alexander Borodin, String Quartet No. 2 in D major, III. Notturno; Musopen String Quartet, Musopen Kickstarter Project, 2012. Public domain; via Wikimedia Commons. No audio edits.
